name: mugi-upscale
description: Development tooling for Mugi. The app itself is Swift and Python.

scripts.check:syntax: sh -n build-app.sh && sh -n setup.sh && sh -n scripts/smoke-upscale.sh && bash -n packaging/build-dmg.sh && python3 -m py_compile upscale.py seedvr2.py
scripts.test: uv run --no-project --with pillow==13.0.0 python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.check: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check:syntax && pnpm run check:lock && pnpm run test
scripts.lint:shell: shellcheck -s sh build-app.sh setup.sh scripts/smoke-upscale.sh macOS/icon/make-icns.sh && shellcheck -s bash packaging/build-dmg.sh
